name: Grovekeeper Plate
description: Verdigris plates and harvest-gold trim honor the hands that replanted Mara's grove.

name: Skyweaver Tunic
description: Cloud-blue leather with pearl-white seams, cut for the roads Selen refused to forget.

name: Hearthkeeper Robes
description: Ember-red cloth and warm brass recall Hessa's first freely lit kiln.

name: Tidekeeper Robes
description: Deep lagoon silk and silver stitching carry the colors of Dain's returning ferry.

name: Grovekeeper Blade
description: A branching bronze guard and beveled leaf blade frame an inset emerald channel.

name: Skyweaver Dagger
description: A swept crescent blade, hooked star guard and blue inlay catch the light.

name: Hearthkeeper Staff
description: Forged phoenix wings cradle a faceted ember above a wrapped ashwood shaft.

name: Tidekeeper Mace
description: Four swept tide flanges surround a pale aquamarine core and bronze wave collars.

name: Grovekeeper Shield
description: A scalloped bronze ward carries a raised branching oak and an emerald heart.

name: Skyweaver Tome
description: A bound grimoire wears raised crescent metalwork, star clasps and a sapphire seal.

name: Hearthkeeper Shield
description: A lacquered hearth-red shield-face trimmed in brass, celebrating warmth without ownership.

name: Tidekeeper Tome
description: A lagoon-colored cover bound with silver threads, with space for names still to come.
